metadata.case_name: IP WING CHEONG PLAINTIFF AND KAM LAM TRADING AS KONG FUNG DECORATION WORKS DEFENDANT

injuries.description: Injuries to his left hand fingers and palm; suture of index, middle and ring finger.
source: the Saw rebounded towards the left hand of Mr Ip causing injuries to his left hand fingers and palm.
Suture of index, middle and ring finger was performed.
injuries.icd_description: Multiple open wounds of wrist or hand

injuries.description: Flexor tendon injury of left little finger (flexor tendon repaired); subsequent left little finger flexion contracture requiring tenolysis and full thickness skin graft.
source: The little finger flexor tendon was repaired.
On 1 September 2010, he was re-admitted for tenolysis and full thickness skin graft for his left little finger flexion contracture.
injuries.icd_description: Laceration of flexor muscle, fascia or tendon of other finger at wrist or hand level

injuries.description: Digital nerves and arteries to the left fingers were beyond repair.
source: The digital nerves and arteries were beyond repair.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of multiple sites of hand

injuries.description: Infection of skin graft requiring debridement; full thickness skin graft taken from groin.
source: On 1 September 2010, he was re-admitted for tenolysis and full thickness skin graft for his left little finger flexion contracture. The skin graft was taken from his groin.
On 21 September 2010, he was admitted again for debridement due to an infection of his skin graft.
injuries.icd_description: Injuries to the wrist or hand

manifestations.description: Apart from the thumb, all fingers in his left hand still suffered from different level of numbness.
He could not stretch his little finger to its full extent.
He could not bend his ring finger in full.
Because of the medical condition of his left fingers, he cannot now play darts which he loved to play prior to the accident.

treatments_received: Suture of index, middle and ring finger
Flexor tendon repair of little finger
Occupational therapy (9 sessions from 21 June 2010 to 20 August 2010)

losses.description: Injury to left hand including digital nerve and artery damage, tendon injury and scarring from skin graft.

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: Because of the medical condition of his left fingers, he cannot now play darts which he loved to play prior to the accident.
Present condition of the left hand fingers will cause him disadvantage in looking for another job if he loses his present employment.
